reason: Hypothesis A proposes a physically sound mechanism (Mn-induced antiferromagnetic coupling and lattice strain for domain wall pinning) that directly addresses the limitation of low coercivity in prior FeCoNiPd/Pt alloys, while maintaining high-entropy constraints.
